title: Home
description: What the cluster is doing right now. Drill-downs hold the history.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: CPU per node, now. The marks on the rim are the warning and critical thresholds.

targets.expr: sort_by_label(100 * (1 - avg by (node) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle"}[5m]))), "node")

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Memory per node, now. The marks on the rim are the warning and critical thresholds.

targets.expr: sort_by_label(100 * (1 - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes), "node")

panels.title: Disk
panels.description: Disk per node, now. The marks on the rim are the warning and critical thresholds.

targets.expr: sort_by_label(100 * (1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{mountpoint="/"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{mountpoint="/"}), "node")

panels.title: Private services: traffic, last 5 minutes
panels.description: Every HTTPRoute behind the private Traefik gateway, with its first hostname. 4xx and 5xx are the share of that service's responses. Public routes are on the HAProxy edge board.

targets.expr: (sum by (route) (rate(traefik_service_requests_total[5m]))) * on (route) group_left (namespace, httproute, hostname) limitk(1, label_join(gateway_httproute_hostname_info, "route", "-", "namespace", "httproute")) by (route)

(100 * sum by (route) (rate(traefik_service_requests_total[5m])) / scalar(sum(rate(traefik_service_requests_total[5m])))) * on (route) group_left (namespace, httproute, hostname) limitk(1, label_join(gateway_httproute_hostname_info, "route", "-", "namespace", "httproute")) by (route)

(100 * sum by (route) (rate(traefik_service_requests_total{code=~"4.."}[5m])) / sum by (route) (rate(traefik_service_requests_total[5m])) or on (route) (0 * sum by (route) (rate(traefik_service_requests_total[5m])))) * on (route) group_left (namespace, httproute, hostname) limitk(1, label_join(gateway_httproute_hostname_info, "route", "-", "namespace", "httproute")) by (route)

(100 * sum by (route) (rate(traefik_service_requests_total{code=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum by (route) (rate(traefik_service_requests_total[5m])) or on (route) (0 * sum by (route) (rate(traefik_service_requests_total[5m])))) * on (route) group_left (namespace, httproute, hostname) limitk(1, label_join(gateway_httproute_hostname_info, "route", "-", "namespace", "httproute")) by (route)

(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, route) (rate(traefik_service_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])))) * on (route) group_left (namespace, httproute, hostname) limitk(1, label_join(gateway_httproute_hostname_info, "route", "-", "namespace", "httproute")) by (route)

panels.title: Public responses per minute
panels.description: Every response from the public edge, stacked by status class. A tall yellow 4xx stack is a scan; raspberry is our own failures.

targets.expr: sum by (code) (increase(haproxy_frontend_http_responses_total{job="network/haproxy-public",proxy=~"hug_.+",code=~"[1-5]xx"}[1m]))

panels.title: Public response time
panels.description: Median, 95th and 99th percentile time for services behind the public edge to send response headers, from HAProxy access logs. Private services are on Private gateway.

targets.expr: _stream:{kubernetes.pod_namespace="network",kubernetes.container_name="hug"} kubernetes.pod_name:haproxy-public-* status:* -frontend:stats frontend:hug_* trs_ms:>=0 | stats quantile(0.5, trs_ms) p50, quantile(0.95, trs_ms) p95, quantile(0.99, trs_ms) p99

panels.title: Services: resources
panels.description: Every workload, heaviest memory first. Bars are usage against the workload's own limit (or volume size); no bar means no limit. Memory includes page cache, which the kernel reclaims under pressure. Disk covers replicated volumes only: local-path volumes report no usage.

targets.expr: sum by (namespace, workload) (label_replace(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{metrics_path="/metrics/resource",container!=""}[5m]), "workload", "$1$2$3", "pod", "(.+?)(?:-[0-9a-f]{6,10})?-[0-9a-z]{5}|(.+)-[0-9]+|(.+)"))

100 * sum by (namespace, workload) (label_replace(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{metrics_path="/metrics/resource",container!=""}[5m]), "workload", "$1$2$3", "pod", "(.+?)(?:-[0-9a-f]{6,10})?-[0-9a-z]{5}|(.+)-[0-9]+|(.+)")) / sum by (namespace, workload) (label_replace(kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="cpu"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () (kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Running"} == 1), "workload", "$1$2$3", "pod", "(.+?)(?:-[0-9a-f]{6,10})?-[0-9a-z]{5}|(.+)-[0-9]+|(.+)"))

sum by (namespace, workload) (label_replace(container_memory_working_set_bytes{metrics_path="/metrics/resource",container!=""}, "workload", "$1$2$3", "pod", "(.+?)(?:-[0-9a-f]{6,10})?-[0-9a-z]{5}|(.+)-[0-9]+|(.+)"))

100 * sum by (namespace, workload) (label_replace(container_memory_working_set_bytes{metrics_path="/metrics/resource",container!=""}, "workload", "$1$2$3", "pod", "(.+?)(?:-[0-9a-f]{6,10})?-[0-9a-z]{5}|(.+)-[0-9]+|(.+)")) / sum by (namespace, workload) (label_replace(kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="memory"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () (kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Running"} == 1), "workload", "$1$2$3", "pod", "(.+?)(?:-[0-9a-f]{6,10})?-[0-9a-z]{5}|(.+)-[0-9]+|(.+)"))

sum by (namespace, workload) (label_replace(kube_pod_spec_volumes_persistentvolumeclaims_info * on (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) group_left () max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes), "workload", "$1$2$3", "pod", "(.+?)(?:-[0-9a-f]{6,10})?-[0-9a-z]{5}|(.+)-[0-9]+|(.+)"))

100 * sum by (namespace, workload) (label_replace(kube_pod_spec_volumes_persistentvolumeclaims_info * on (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) group_left () max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes), "workload", "$1$2$3", "pod", "(.+?)(?:-[0-9a-f]{6,10})?-[0-9a-z]{5}|(.+)-[0-9]+|(.+)")) / sum by (namespace, workload) (label_replace(kube_pod_spec_volumes_persistentvolumeclaims_info * on (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) group_left () max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes), "workload", "$1$2$3", "pod", "(.+?)(?:-[0-9a-f]{6,10})?-[0-9a-z]{5}|(.+)-[0-9]+|(.+)"))

panels.title: Top clients, last 15 minutes
panels.description: Public edge only, from HAProxy access logs. One client with many failed requests over many paths is a scanner.

targets.expr: _time:15m _stream:{kubernetes.pod_namespace="network",kubernetes.container_name="hug"} kubernetes.pod_name:haproxy-public-* status:* -frontend:stats | stats by (client_ip) count() requests, count() if (status:>=400) failed, count_uniq(path) paths, count_uniq(host) hosts | sort by (requests desc) | limit 15

panels.title: Most hit paths, last 15 minutes
panels.description: Public edge only, from HAProxy access logs; query strings are never logged.

targets.expr: _time:15m _stream:{kubernetes.pod_namespace="network",kubernetes.container_name="hug"} kubernetes.pod_name:haproxy-public-* status:* -frontend:stats | stats by (path) count() requests, count_uniq(client_ip) clients, count() if (status:>=400) failed | sort by (requests desc) | limit 15

panels.title: Public status mix, 15 minutes
panels.description: What the public edge answered lately.

targets.expr: sum by (code) (increase(haproxy_frontend_http_responses_total{job="network/haproxy-public",proxy=~"hug_.+",code=~"[1-5]xx"}[15m]))

panels.title: Alerts
panels.description: When each alert was firing. The right edge is now.

targets.expr: max by (alertname) (ALERTS{alertstate="firing",severity="warning"}) or 2 * max by (alertname) (ALERTS{alertstate="firing",severity="critical"})
